description: This file defines the Attribute class used to model product attributes in the shopping application. It extends ShopEntity and includes properties like name, type, code, and associated attribute values.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a product attribute with properties like name, type, code, and values, used within the shopping catalog.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attribute

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the attribute

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the attribute

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the attribute

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Assigns a list of AttributeValue objects to the attribute

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the list of AttributeValue objects

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the attribute

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifier for the attribute
